theme: Object register and input gates for inscription units and competing readings
question: Can directions 1, 2 and 7 begin in parallel from a shared object register and explicit source gaps?
outcome: Three owned packages implement the base register, a register-aware unit-study queue, and lexical repairs plus participant checks. Independent accounting reproduces 4695 provisional families and 5680 faces; all 118 divided faces join the register, with three image-review flags. Twenty-one reading-input tests pass on coordinator rerun. No fresh cohort is certified or opened.
challenge: The source record contains disputed catalogue readings, provisional physical identities, ambiguous image links, lexical matching defects and incomplete exposure histories.
remedy: Preserve alternatives and earlier outputs, use canonical value statuses, withhold unresolved fields from accepted values, propagate image flags into queues, repair exact lookup, and require reviewed inputs before a prospective freeze.
retry_when: Reviewed image and lexical annotations, remaining source adapters, or adjudicated exposure histories close a named gate; preserve this first implementation record.
